question: Should `/v1/chat/completions` expose internal OpenClaw tool telemetry, and if so should it be a redacted opt-in diagnostic/API mode rather than normal OpenAI `tool_calls`?
rationale: Current shipped behavior intentionally maps OpenAI `tool_calls` to caller-supplied HTTP tools, while internal tool telemetry can reveal sensitive operator context and changes the public API contract.

options.title: Keep client-tool-only default
options.body: Leave normal Chat Completions `tool_calls` scoped to caller-supplied tools and direct internal-tool observability to existing Gateway/session/trace surfaces until a separate design is approved.

options.title: Design opt-in telemetry
options.body: Add a redacted, explicitly enabled diagnostic or trace mode for internal tool starts/results with audience, retention, and security rules documented before implementation.

options.title: Expose directly
options.body: Treat internal tool starts as normal Chat Completions `tool_calls`, accepting the compatibility and leakage risk as a deliberate API change.

recommendation.title: Keep client-tool-only default
recommendation.body: Leave normal Chat Completions `tool_calls` scoped to caller-supplied tools and direct internal-tool observability to existing Gateway/session/trace surfaces until a separate design is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the gateway OpenAI-compatible API and security boundary, and steipete has merge/follow-up history on this exact endpoint plus recent gateway API work.
